provenance.handling: Original files and compiled artifacts retained outside the submission. JSON report contents are unchanged; text extraction is identified per artifact. Operational connection, image, allocation and payment metadata are excluded. No measurements were changed or discarded.

limitations: Real checkpoint weights use synthetic activations; captured model inputs remain untested.
Replay uses a separate process and compilation cache on the same device and software environment; independent-environment replay remains untested.
Ordinary PyTorch BF16 is faster in these measurements and is not established as a byte-invariant baseline.
The global import warns that optional core extension _C is unavailable. Actual execution traces confirm the explicit Triton backend with fallback=false.
CPU affinity reports visible logical CPUs, not an allocation or throughput guarantee.
No full-model, tensor-parallel, multi-device, double-backward or production acceptance is claimed.
